entries.question: Q1
entries.citation: Bates AS, Phelps JS, Kim M, et al., Wilson RI, Lee WA (2026) Distributed control circuits across a brain-and-cord connectome. Nature 656:957-970; with the BANC v888 metadata (banc_888_meta.feather, sha 86ccf5df...)
entries.method: BANC expert review and annotation of VNC hair plate neurons citing Pratt 2026 (ref. 222) among others; leg sensory neurons identified by morphological comparison to the literature (Lee 2025, ref. 223) (Methods)
entries.summary: 25 BANC v888 rows name CoHP8 (annotation query): 12 typed SNpp45 and 3 SNpp52 with peripheral_target_type "CoHP8,hair_plate", all entering via the ventral prothoracic nerve; 10 typed CoHP8, of which 9 enter via the prothoracic leg nerve and 8 carry seed_10 "front_leg,trochanter_hair_plate". The label spans three BANC types and is internally inconsistent, so it is recorded as a candidate set (M-B). The paper does not state that BANC "CoHP" equals Pratt "CxHP"; the numbers and nerves correspond.

check.note: BANC annotation counts confirmed locally (A3-A6). Bates 2026 method sentence confirmed verbatim ("additional expert review and annotation of chordotonal, campaniform and hair plate neurons of the VNC", Methods); refs 222/223 cited there, but that ref 222 is Pratt 2026 was NOT FOUND verbatim (reference list not read), and for sensory neurons the checker read "comparisons to the literature and the domain expertise of our authors" (morphological comparison is stated for effectors). Neither CoHP nor CxHP appears in the text read. So the link of the BANC label to the target plate is not confirmed: not counted. Local checker note: fanc_cell_type also carries CoHP labels, with some disagreements between columns.
check.by: separate web-reading agent, 2026-11-23 + separate local-reading agent (read-only), 2026-11-23

check.note: C5 confirmed: passive slow movement on a manually controlled 3-axis platform; maximal calcium at combined adduction and inward rotation (Fig. 1G-H); no evidence for phasic tuning (Discussion); genotype from Table 1. Calcium-imaging Methods not read verbatim.

entries.question: Q4
stimulated: locust ventral coxal hair plate long hairs
recorded: posterior rotator, adductor and anterior rotator coxa motor neurons
entries.citation: Kuenzi F, Burrows M (1995) Central connections of sensory neurones from a hair plate proprioceptor in the thoraco-coxal joint of the locust. J Exp Biol 198:1589
entries.method: selective hair stimulation; intracellular motor neuron recording
entries.summary: Grade C (locust). Long hairs deflected as the leg swings forward; stimulation evokes a resistance reflex rotating the coxa posteriorly; posterior rotator and adductor MNs excited (partly monosynaptic), anterior rotator inhibited. No pair maps to our targets (other insect).

check.note: K1 confirmed: long hairs deflected by the trochantin as the leg swings forward; resistance reflex rotating the coxa posteriorly; posterior rotator and adductor MNs excited, anterior rotator inhibited; excitation partly by direct connections.

check.note: P1 confirmed: short-latency monosynaptic EPSPs, disynaptic IPSPs; the abstract names "femur flexor motoneurones" for the EPSPs and no target for the IPSPs; abstract truncated in Europe PMC.
